summary: The interview excerpt presents how Zappos integrated Twitter into its culture and customer relationship practices. Alfred Lin describes a bottom-up adoption that began with Tony Hsieh's suggestion, expanded to hundreds of employees, and aimed to strengthen internal bonds and enable serendipitous encounters across locations. The discussion emphasizes that many tweets are authentic daily-life updates rather than promotional messages, contributing to customers feeling personally connected to the people behind the brand. The core lesson is that social media can humanize commerce when used to foster real human interaction among employees and with customers, rather than as a pure marketing tool.
title: Zappos Twitter Adoption: Culture, Serendipity, and Customer Connection
